attributes.name: Druva - Audit Record With Missing Event ID
attributes.description: Detects audit record with missing event id in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects audit record with missing event id in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type == "Admin Audit Trail" AND event.id IS NULL
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
